# UNCODE (previously PC-Sampler)

> UNCODE (UNmasking Calibration for DecOding DEbiasing), previously released as PC-Sampler (Position-aware Calibration of Decoding Bias), is a training-free decoding-calibration method for masked diffusion language models (MDMs) such as LLaDA and Dream. It fixes two systematic biases of uncertainty-based samplers and improves reasoning and planning by over 7% across 3 MDMs and 7 benchmarks. Paper: "Empirical Analysis of Decoding Biases in Masked Diffusion Models" (Huang et al., ACL 2026 Main Conference, arXiv:2508.13021).

Uncertainty-based samplers (confidence, entropy, margin) applied to masked diffusion models show two decoding biases:

- Rigid boundary bias: boundary tokens (BOS/EOS, sentence edges) are decoded first, collapsing decoding into a fixed U-shaped trajectory that commits to an answer before the reasoning is built.
- Trivial token bias: high-frequency, low-information tokens (punctuation, spaces, fillers) are over-prioritized, spending the decoding budget on surface structure instead of content.

UNCODE multiplies two priors onto the existing uncertainty score — a position-aware prior that regulates the global decoding trajectory and a content-aware informativeness prior that down-weights trivial tokens. No fine-tuning and no architecture change are needed.

Key results:

- LLaDA-8B-Instruct: average over HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH500, GPQA, Countdown and Sudoku rises from 33.6 (confidence sampler) to 42.7 with UNCODE, beating entropy, margin, EB-Sampler, Semi-AR and Fast-dLLM decoding.
- LLaDA-1.5-8B + UNCODE reaches 44.7 average, comparable to the autoregressive Qwen-2.5-7B (45.3).
- UNCODE is compatible with efficient decoding (fast samplers), preserving their 2x-4x speedups while improving accuracy.

- [Paper (ACL Anthology)](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.311/): official ACL 2026 version, DOI 10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.311
- [Paper (arXiv 2508.13021)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.13021): v1 is titled "PC-Sampler: Position-Aware Calibration of Decoding Bias in Masked Diffusion Models"
- [Code (GitHub)](https://github.com/NEUIR/Uncode): evaluation scripts for UNCODE and baseline samplers

- [Project page](https://passionate11.github.io/Uncode-project-page/)
